hypothesis: A Norman-source-selected observed-single correction transfers without target-label fitting to local Adamson UPR genetic pairs across three declared drug backgrounds
evidence_level: external-source feasibility; first local Opal score on this source, widely published data; not powered independent joint confirmation
source: Norman88 exposed development pairs, original count-preserving log2 preparation; no historic evaluator access
query: Original GEO GSE90546 GSM2406677 counts and guide metadata already local; three canonical pair identities in three backgrounds. A real triple exists but remains inventory-only because only one triple identity exists.
context_mapping: Publisher methods p29: gemgroup1 tunicamycin4ug/mL, gemgroup2 thapsigargin100nM, gemgroup3 DMSO. Context and capture library are confounded; barcode suffixes alone are not proof of biology or culture independence.
information: Measured exact construct singles and matched three-guide negative controls within each query drug background. Query pair labels forbidden in gene selection, fitting, preprocessing, model selection, pretraining and calibration; no external pretrained weights.
qualification: Verify all original file hashes against download manifests; full barcode joins, good coverage and singlet calls, exact eight factorial genetic conditions, original raw-count provenance, source/query Ensembl overlap and declared GEO local-reuse/no-redistribution terms before scores.
preprocessing: Keep full barcodes including gemgroup. Canonical aliases ATF6,PERK=EIF2AK3,IRE1=ERN1; exact author constructs, unknown labels excluded. Use frozen Norman library normalizer14048; log2 of normalized condition mean relative to matched same-background controls. QC minimum library500, upper99.5percentile of permitted query controls/singles, minimum50 cells/condition. Gene panel is source-selected Norman genes intersecting query metadata only; no query response/DE gene selection.
source_selection: Three random source-only folds, seed20261007; fixed mean/global/summed-single/pair-product/mixed menu reused. Choose strongest simple and strongest pair families by source-only validation MSE, then refit source88 pairs. Freeze predictions and hashes before opening prepared evaluator responses.
endpoint: Equal-condition all-aligned-gene total MSE over nine exact pair/background means, with each family retained and per-pair/background errors. Do not compare raw MSE to old datasets with different gene panels.
uncertainty: 2000 crossed background/target diagnostic bootstrap draws, fixed shared reference means and source selection; no independent cultures or biological-confidence claim
decision: 5percent relative MSE improvement and positive diagnostic lower bound are development materiality only. Report failures and smaller effects; no post-query family replacement. No automatic context encoder, higher-order model, calibration, acquisition or scaling advancement.
missing_for_flagship: Globally held pair panels with adequate independent identity coverage
